item.blurb: Slingshot Insurance Raises $27M Seed. Slingshot Insurance raises $27 million in seed funding to expand its AI-native infrastructure platform for the embedded insurance market.
BOB Raises $5.5M Seed. BOB raises $5.5M in seed funding led by Mischief to expand its AI-powered financial assistant for small business owners.
Vitalls Raises $1.5M Seed. Vitalls raises $1.5 million in seed funding from EST Growmore to expand its AI-powered digital health passport platform for managing medical records.
Cognitive Credit Raises $40M Growth Capital. Cognitive Credit raises $40M in growth capital led by Summit Partners to scale its AI-powered data and analytics platform for global credit markets.
